title: Honor one existing Persona schedule deadline across BFF and adapter RPCs
summary: Fixes hosted Persona creation schedule registration boundary failure on Root 38406522993 (where cron.list failed refusing to register blind: timed out) by establishing a single monotonic schedule-operation deadline covering initial cron.list and pagination, mutation (cron.add/cron.update/cron.remove), ambiguous-response reconciliation, authoritative readback, and poll sleeps. Replaces uncoordinated 30s socket timeouts and fresh RPC allocations with remaining-budget calculation against the 180s provisioning lease (PANTHEON_PERSONA_PROVISIONING_LEASE_SECONDS), downstream adapter CLI cap (170s), response allowance (2.0s), and ~8-10s generic CLI startup overhead. Propagates process allowance strictly via request body timeout_seconds to OpenClaw gateway adapter and _gateway_call, bounds adapter namespace guard lookups to the same remaining request allowance, rejects late readback success after deadline expiry, and preserves fail-closed list-before-add and compensation semantics.

acceptance_verification.description: Before edits inspect exact current protected dev and cited original first-failure/source evidence, original superseded task and existing budget/registration/reconciliation mechanisms. Use one clean task worktree, only listed existing production/tests plus mandatory evidence. Do not run another hosted request, CLI, provider, cron write, deploy or mutate data; source worker remains local-only. Preserve original failure and diagnostic limitation; same-path later success is not a source fix.

Implement the smallest bounded deadline contract in the existing required first-evaluation registration entry and existing registrar/runtime. A single monotonic schedule-operation deadline must encompass initial list and pagination, normal mutation, existing ambiguous-response reconciliation, authoritative readback and poll sleep; they spend remaining time rather than receive fresh full budgets. Reuse semantically appropriate existing controls, document exact default arithmetic against actual 180sec HTTP request/provisioning lease including response allowance, and account for the real generic CLI startup overhead. Preserve the existing readback policy where applicable and no late success after expiry. Do not add a new arbitrary configuration ladder or claim an isolated 30->180 change solves the operation. No full-saga timing framework/coordinator-store redesign.

Along the existing authenticated /api/openclaw-adapter/gateway/cron request, propagate only the remaining bounded RPC/process allowance into the existing provider _gateway_call(timeout_seconds=...) mechanism. HTTP waiting must cover that admitted process allowance plus response while remaining within the operation deadline. Owner/namespace guard lookups must also spend the same remaining request allowance. Preserve genuine service auth, method allowlist, tenant/persona/runtime/PCB owner identity, existing response contract and provider cap. No new endpoint, WS client, alternative CLI/transport, daemon, generic wrapper/cache/retry service, public authorization header, MFA/issuer/grant, health writer, scheduler or dependency.

Keep authoritative list-before-add failclosed, stable request identity, original exact-one owner reconciliation and original unknown-response readback. On expired/unavailable/invalid owner listing do not register blind, restart an operation automatically, fabricate readiness or convert unknown mutation into known failure/success; preserve normal compensation semantics. Do not lower gates or thresholds, delete old jobs, seed scheduling data, swap provider accounts or change paper/live/capital authority. This scope does not implement unrelated UI/finance/research features.

Extend the listed existing regression modules to call actual original functions and composition, not a copied validator. Meaningfully prove a legitimate delayed list exceeding the former 30sec but fitting the single operation budget can reach exact authoritative schedule readback; cumulative multi-RPC work/pagination and poll sleeps shrink the same deadline; provider and namespace lookup budgets cannot outlive caller; expired/late result, timeout/error/malformed/auth and owned-target rejection cannot pass or issue blind add. Retain existing response-loss/idempotency/owner-negative cases. Use controlled time/process fixtures without actual 30sec sleeps or hosted calls, and distinguish local composition tests from real provider evidence.

Finish native source delivery with relevant complete affected modules/syntax/diff checks and truthful exact counts/failures/skips, mandatory evidence, genuine owner trailers, original assigned independent reviewer, one task branch/one PR, required CI/current-dev integration and native archive. Never fake reviewer identity/rejection/attestation or use vN branches. Ordinary authorized dev commands need no repeated user approval. Source merge remains source-only: sole original release coordinator must run fresh same-version FULL before first exact FE312/newBE Root with actual hosted normal-flow/Workshop persistence/plannedrollback and remaining L1-L12 finance/provider/ONE applicable real-human/independent overall acceptance. Parent 6AC/21deps/3artifacts stay unchanged; do not add product acceptance gates.
